name: Madara Uchiha [The Final Battle]
balanceNote: Screenshot coefficients are not specified. All damaging skills, counterattacks and Inferno use buffed Physical ATK against Physical DEF. Mystery and chase target all living enemies as requested. Pure Taijutsu immunity applies to explicitly pure Taijutsu attacks; Physical ATK conversion does not reclassify mixed elemental techniques as pure Taijutsu.

mystery.name: Fire Style - Majestic Fire Destruction
mystery.description: Causes damage and Combustion to up to 9 units in the opponent's field, causes Fire Engulfment and Interruption to the selected unit.

standard.name: Susano'o - Sever
standard.description: Attacks the line of opponents in front, high chance of causing Knockdown and reduces Madara's Mystery Cooldown by 1. This skill is unavoidable.

chase.name: Fire Style - Great Fire Annihilation
chase.description: Triggered with at least 20 Combo, causes damage, Inferno to up to 7 units in the opponent's field and reduces their Standard Attack attempt by 1. This skill ignores a small amount of Resistance.

complete.name: Complete Body - Susano'o
complete.description: Causes damage and 3 Combo to up to 12 units in the opponent's field, causes Knockdown, Suppress Super Armor until the end of the next round and Defense Shatter to the selected unit.

burstMystery.name: Susano'o - Majestic Attire
burstMystery.description: Causes damage neglecting Shields and 5 Combo to all units in the opponent's field, causes Knockdown, Immobile and Suppress Immunity until the end of the next round to the selected unit.

burstStandard.name: Susano'o - Twin Blade Dance
burstStandard.description: Attacks all units in the opponent's lineup and reduces their Resistance by 10% (stackable), high chance of causing Knockdown and Defense Shatter to a unit hit. This skill is unavoidable.

burstChase.name: Fire Style - Great Fire Annihilation
burstChase.description: Triggered with at least 20 Combo, causes unavoidable damage and Inferno to up to 12 units in the opponent's field. This skill ignores a small amount of Resistance and has additional Critical Rate increase.

summon.name: Shadow Clone Jutsu
summon.description: Whenever Madara enters the field, summons a Madara Shadow Clone with 60% HP, then Madara becomes immune to Interruption until the end of the round and if he suffers the first fatal damage within that round, escapes death and recovers 30% HP. Madara Shadow Clone has Super Armor, is immune to Pure Taijutsu damage and when it suffers the first Trigger damage in a round, causes unavoidable damage and Mental Breakdown to up to 2 ninjas in the opponent's lineup having the lowest HP and if this skill defeats a unit, additionally causes True damage to all remaining units in that lineup based on 100% of the Clone's max HP (max of 30000).

cloneCounter.name: Genjutsu - Sharingan
cloneCounter.description: Madara Shadow Clone's Additional Skill: Causes unavoidable damage and Mental Breakdown (Level 2 Debuff: Whenever units affected execute an action, reduces that unit's lineup's Critical Rate by 15% (stackable up to 4 times) until the end of the round and dispels their Perseverance. Lasts until the end of the round.) to the opponent ninja with the lowest HP. If this skill defeats a unit, additionally causes True damage to all remaining units in that lineup based on 100% of the Clone's max HP (max of 30000).

reflection.name: Uchiha Reflection
reflection.description: Madara has high chances to evade an attack every round and if he evades one, recovers 30% HP and counterattacks with 20% of his current HP. Whenever Madara evades the first attack in a round, scales his Ninjutsu by 15%.

burst.name: Chakra Burst
burst.description: At the end of the round, deactivates Chakra Burst, increase Madara's Chase damage by 10% (stackable) and all of Madara's other skills changes to non-breakthrough State, during that battle.

cloneSplash.name: Burst - Genjutsu - Mangekyo Sharingan
cloneSplash.description: Additional Skill: Causes unavoidable damage, Interruption, Mental Breakdown to the unit in front and up to 7 opponent units suffering from Inferno, dispels their Perseverance and reduces Madara's Mystery Cooldown by 1.

chases.name: Fire Style - Great Fire Annihilation
chases.description: Triggered with at least 20 Combo, causes damage, Inferno to up to 7 units in the opponent's field and reduces their Standard Attack attempt by 1. This skill ignores a small amount of Resistance.

passives.name: Chakra Burst
passives.description: After Madara executes Fire Style - Majestic Fire Destruction, executes Additional Skill: Complete Body - Susano'o. Madara can have up to 2 Technique Points and for every 1 he has, increase his Resistance by 20%. When he suffers damage, receives 0.5 Technique Point and when he has 2, consumes all to enter Chakra Burst until the end of the round.

passives.name: Susano'o - Absolute Protection
passives.description: Madara has Super Armor and is immune to Pure Taijutsu damage. Whenever Madara suffers the first damage in a round, increase his Critical Rate by 50% until the end of the round.

passives.name: Susano'o - Absolute Protection
passives.description: Madara has Level 2 Super Armor and is immune to Pure Taijutsu damage. Whenever Madara suffers the first damage in a round, increase his Critical Rate by 50% and reduces his Mystery's Chakra Cost to 0, last until the end of the round. Every time Madara causes Critical Hit to 1 unit, increase his Ninjutsu by 10% (stackable).
